title: Coarse generic finite trace filtration with constant vector-space quotients
statement: Let k be algebraically closed and C/k a smooth integral affine connected curve [def-sc-curves], with generic inclusion eta and function field K [def-sc-function-field]. Assume every finite extension L/K has a finite normalization model C_L [def-fin-normalization-extension] that is smooth affine connected over k, with generic field identified with L compatibly over C. For a torsion generic abelian etale sheaf M [def-weil-pbc-torsion-etale-sheaf] with finite geometric stalk [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], there are finitely many smooth integral affine connected curves D_i/k and finite generic chains F_i(0)=0,...,F_i(n_i). Each successive step is a short exact sequence with first and second terms identified with consecutive chain terms and third term identified with a finite iterated binary direct sum (possibly the zero object) of the constant Z/ell sheaf [def-sc-constant-sheaves] for a prime ell. H²(C,eta_*M) [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] injects into the product of H²(D_i,eta_i*F_i(n_i)). No cohomology vanishing assumption is made.

proof.text: Identify M with its finite continuous Galois module via the stalk equivalence. Decompose into finitely many invariant primary summands.

For each primary summand use the Sylow filtration with trivial finite prime-field vector-space quotients and the subgroup fixed field. Identify each quotient with a finite direct sum of prime constants by a basis. Transport the chain to generic sheaves without refining it by rank-one flags.

Take the finite separable fixed field L of the open subgroup. Restriction followed by trace is multiplication by [L:K]. Since this is prime to ell, Bezout rescaling with an annihilating power of ell gives a retraction.

Apply hmodel to L and identify its spectrum with the generic point of the normalization D. Composition of direct images identifies the pushed-forward restriction with the finite direct image of the terminal filtration term. Exact finite pushforward and its cohomology comparison transport the retraction to an injection into H² on D.

Finite direct sums are preserved by additive direct image and cohomology. Combine the primary injections using their decomposition projections. Encode the chains by F_i(a), with initial zero term and short exact finite direct sums of prime constant quotients. For the zero module use r=0 and the empty product.
